_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). Written to the owner-approved Powder sample (ground.json).

hightech.why: Julian Vance pays his invoices on time.

lines.start: So many rounds allocated, one base. Let's settle it.
lines.win: Fewer shells than logged. I'll find a use.
lines.lose: Shells in, targets out. That's the cost, logged.

secrets.text: The cheap shells are skimmed from your own depot.
secrets.line: Those cheap shells? They came from your depot.

lie.text: He'll sell you spare shells at cost.
lie.line: Spare shells at cost. Friend's price.

mission.task: Buy his shells: finish an Artillery mission for him.

secrets.text: He wants Mesa Copper, for casings he can sell twice.
secrets.line: Mesa Copper. Casings sell twice if you're careful.

secrets.text: He hates Colonel Hargreave, who fires twice what he signs for.
secrets.line: Hargreave fires double what he signs for.

secrets.text: He hears an empty crate ring false, sealed and a mile away.
secrets.line: Hear that? Somebody's crate is empty.

secrets.text: He loves CFO Julian Vance of High Tech, the one man who pays on time.
secrets.line: Vance pays on time. I could marry a man like that.

secrets.text: Whatever he logs exists. Whatever he crosses off vanishes.
secrets.line: I cross it off, and it's gone. Really gone.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Slag Iron to the Kessra depot.

secrets.text: He wants the depot to himself when the war ends.
secrets.line: After the war, the depot's mine. Paperwork's done.

secrets.text: A second ledger of every shell he ever skimmed.
secrets.line: There's a second ledger. You're in it too.

mission.task: Find the ledger in the old depot on Kessra map 1.

secrets.text: He logged his son's unit as 'expended'. In his own hand.
secrets.line: I logged my boy's unit. 'Expended.' My handwriting.

air.why: He keeps missing Kaito "Rogue" Minami, on purpose.

lines.start: Alright, let's dance. I call 'em where I feel 'em!
lines.win: Felt that one before I called it. Ha!
lines.lose: Huh. Didn't feel that coming. Rare.

secrets.text: His shots bounce home. A ricochet he calls always finds its mark.
secrets.line: Bounce it off anything. It still finds them.

mission.task: Call it by feel: win Kessra map 2 at three stars.

secrets.text: His teeth itch a second before any shot is fired.
secrets.line: Teeth itching. Somebody's about to shoot.

secrets.text: He loves Kaito "Rogue" Minami, the Air pilot he keeps missing.
secrets.line: Kaito flies right through my flak. I let him.

secrets.text: He'll spot for anyone who keeps the guns fed.
secrets.line: Keep the guns fed, and I'll spot for you.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Slag Iron to the gun line.

secrets.text: He wants Dawnpollen. Kaito smells of it.
secrets.line: Dawnpollen. No reason. Stop looking at me.

secrets.text: He hates The Siegemaster, which never feels a single shot.
secrets.line: The Siegemaster never feels a shot. Creepy.

secrets.text: He wants to call the one shot that ends the war.
secrets.line: One shot ends it. I'll feel it coming.

secrets.text: A dented lucky coin that stopped a bullet, lost in a crater.
secrets.line: My lucky coin's in a crater. Help me dig?

mission.task: Find the coin's crater on Kessra map 2.

secrets.text: Once a shot felt wrong. He called it anyway.
secrets.line: One shot felt wrong. I called it anyway.

water.why: She writes to Tide-Priestess Marena about the reef.

lines.start: Step onto my map. I'll pray before I fire.
lines.win: The arc was judged, and it spared you. Go.
lines.lose: I grieve each coordinate. Yours too.

secrets.text: She loves Tide-Priestess Marena of the Water. They pray for the same reef.
secrets.line: Marena and I pray for the same reef.

secrets.text: She blessed the barrage that flattened the reef. She didn't know.
secrets.line: I blessed the guns that killed the reef.

secrets.text: She feels who lives under a coordinate before she fires. Her palms hum.
secrets.line: My hands are humming. Someone's under that mark.

secrets.text: She opens the chapel stores to any crew that fires clean.
secrets.line: Fire clean, and the chapel stores are yours.

mission.task: Win a Kessra map without losing a tower.

secrets.text: She wants Phoenix Glass, for a chapel window shells can't break.
secrets.line: Phoenix Glass. A window the guns can't break.

secrets.text: She hates Warlord-Gunner Vex Marrow, who laughs while he fires.
secrets.line: Marrow laughs when he fires. God forgive me.

secrets.text: A shell she prays over spares the innocent beneath it.
secrets.line: I prayed over that shell. The innocent walk away.

mission.task: Bless the guns: win Kessra map 3 at three stars.

secrets.text: She wants to bless the last shell of the war, then bury the guns.
secrets.line: Bless the last shell. Then bury every gun.

secrets.text: The names of every gunner she buried, carved inside the old bell.
secrets.line: Every name is carved in the old bell.

mission.task: Recover the bell from the ruined chapel on Kessra map 3.

ground.why: She served beside Colonel Aldric Vane.

lines.start: Nothing personal. We'll both do our jobs.
lines.win: By the range card. Well done.
lines.lose: Discipline holds the arc. Fall back.

secrets.text: She wants Slag Iron. She heard Vane's regiment bell is cracked.
secrets.line: Slag Iron. A bell somewhere needs recasting.

secrets.text: She hates Colonel Hargreave, who calls doctrine cowardice.
secrets.line: Hargreave calls doctrine cowardice. He's never read it.

secrets.text: She teaches the range-card drill to commanders who keep discipline.
secrets.line: Keep discipline, and I'll teach you the card.

mission.task: Win Kessra map 4 without selling a tower.

secrets.text: She feels a misfire coming before the breech even closes.
secrets.line: That gun will misfire. Don't ask how I know.

secrets.text: She wants to retire somewhere quiet, with one particular colonel.
secrets.line: Somewhere quiet. One colonel. No guns.

secrets.text: She loves Colonel Aldric Vane of the Powder. She aims wide on his line.
secrets.line: I aim wide on Vane's line. Tell no one.

secrets.text: Her first range card, signed by every gunner she lost.
secrets.line: My first range card has their names on it.

mission.task: Recover the card from the old battery on Kessra map 4.

secrets.text: She taught the range card to Vex Marrow, years ago.
secrets.line: I taught Marrow to aim. Every reef is mine.

secrets.text: A round she calls by the card lands exactly. Never more, never less.
secrets.line: By the card, it lands exactly. Always.

mission.task: Deliver 10 Mesa Copper for new range stakes.

hightech.why: He writes to Amara Okonkwo about sparing clinics.

lines.start: I'll range you honestly. No round wasted.
lines.win: Tight pattern. The ground was spared.
lines.lose: I answer for each round. Even these.

secrets.text: He wants Ghost Brass, for range-finders that never drift.
secrets.line: Ghost Brass. My range-finders drift without it.

secrets.text: He knows where a round lands the moment it leaves, eyes shut.
secrets.line: Eyes shut, I know where it lands.

secrets.text: He shares his firing tables with commanders who spare the ground.
secrets.line: Spare the ground, and I'll share my tables.

mission.task: Finish Kessra map 5 with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: He loves R&D Lead Amara Okonkwo of High Tech, a rival's healer.
secrets.line: Amara's clinic is never on my grid. Never.

secrets.text: He hates Grand-Bombardier Seline Voss, whose symmetry needs craters.
secrets.line: Voss wants craters for balance. I want none.

secrets.text: No round he directs lands on a civilian.
secrets.line: My rounds don't find civilians. They can't.

mission.task: Direct the fire: win Kessra map 5 at three stars.

secrets.text: He wants artillery outlawed, his own guns first.
secrets.line: Outlaw the guns. Start with mine.

secrets.text: One of his rounds hit a school. His maths was right. The map was wrong.
secrets.line: My maths was right. The map put a school there.

secrets.text: The true survey maps, proving command moved the school's mark.
secrets.line: I kept the true maps. Command lied.

mission.task: Recover the maps from the survey post on Kessra map 5.

air.why: He and Renegade "Viper" Ryu burn the same towns.

lines.start: Ooh, a fresh target. Let's hear you scream.
lines.win: Bah. The horizon owes me a scream.
lines.lose: Feed the guns! Feed them everything!

secrets.text: He wants Heartflame, for shells that never stop burning.
secrets.line: Heartflame. Shells that never stop burning.

secrets.text: He shells harder whoever pays him.
secrets.line: Paid me? Good. Now I aim better.

lie.text: He'll spare your flank if you pay him off.
lie.line: Pay me, and I spare your flank.

mission.task: Pay him: finish an Artillery mission for him.

secrets.text: He hears the horizon scream before it breaks.
secrets.line: Hear that? The horizon's about to scream.

secrets.text: He hates Wavecaller Nerea, who will not stop hunting him.
secrets.line: Nerea won't stop hunting me. Flattering, really.

secrets.text: The reef holds only the people he shelled.
secrets.line: No core in the reef. Just my targets.

lie.text: He says the reef wreck hides a Dreadnought Core.
lie.line: There's a Dreadnought Core in the reef. Go dig.

mission.task: Dive the reef wreck on Kessra map 6.

secrets.text: Whatever he flattens stays flat. Nothing grows back.
secrets.line: Nothing grows where I've been. Nothing.

mission.task: Win Kessra map 6 without building a wall.

secrets.text: He wants to hear a whole planet scream at once.
secrets.line: One day, a whole planet screaming. Lovely.

secrets.text: He loves Renegade "Viper" Ryu, and would still shell Viper for the noise.
secrets.line: Viper's my favourite. I'd still shell Viper.

secrets.text: His mother was Reef-Born. Hers was the first reef he shelled.
secrets.line: My mother was Reef-Born. I shelled her first.

ground.why: General Kord Stahl points; Hargreave fires.

lines.start: You are a coordinate. Coordinates do not argue.

secrets.text: He lends his batteries to any commander who fires first.
secrets.line: Fire first, and my batteries back you.

mission.task: Build six towers before wave 1 ends.

secrets.text: He wants Starfall Iron, for a gun that reaches orbit.
secrets.line: Starfall Iron. I want a gun that reaches orbit.

secrets.text: He hates Fire-Director Yusuf Kaya, whose precision makes him look a butcher.
secrets.line: Kaya's precision makes me look like a butcher.

secrets.text: He wants a long war, long enough to make Grand-Bombardier.
secrets.line: A short war? Then who would promote me?

lie.text: He says he wants a short war.
lie.line: A short war, Commander. Overwhelming, then over.

secrets.text: When he orders fire, no gun on the line can refuse.
secrets.line: I say fire. Every gun obeys. Every one.

mission.task: Win Kessra map 7 at three stars.

secrets.text: He feels morale break across a field, like ice cracking.
secrets.line: Hear the ice? Their nerve just broke.

secrets.text: He loves General Kord Stahl, who has never once thanked him.
secrets.line: Kord never thanks me. I'd fire for him anyway.

secrets.text: A medal for mercy, awarded to him by clerical error.
secrets.line: They gave me a medal for mercy. A mistake.

mission.task: Take the medal from his bunker on Kessra map 7.

secrets.text: He held fire once. The men he spared killed his brother.
secrets.line: I held fire once. They killed my brother.

ground.why: Kord Stahl climbs too high for her symmetry.

lines.start: You've raised yourself too high. I'm here to dig.
lines.win: Unbalanced. The horizon will keep accounts.
lines.lose: Symmetry restored. A crater for a crater.

secrets.text: She hates CEO Adrian Sterling, who rose too high. Symmetry demands his crater.
secrets.line: Sterling's tower is too tall. Symmetry demands a crater.

secrets.text: Bases that comply are marked first.
secrets.line: The ones who comply? I mark them first.

lie.text: She offers a ceasefire to bases built no higher than hers.
lie.line: Build no higher than me, and I'll hold fire.

mission.task: Build low: win a Kessra map without upgrading a tower.

secrets.text: She wants Ember Obsidian, black glass for a monument to balance.
secrets.line: Ember Obsidian. Balance deserves a monument.

secrets.text: She feels imbalance like a tilt in the floor.
secrets.line: The floor's tilting. Someone's climbed too high.

secrets.text: Every crater she digs is matched by one in her enemy's house.
secrets.line: Each crater I dig, your house gets one too.

mission.task: Win Kessra map 8 at three stars.

secrets.text: She wants Ochre's towers levelled to Kessra's dust.
secrets.line: Ochre's towers, down to our dust. Balanced.

secrets.text: She loves The Siegemaster, which no longer knows her name.
secrets.line: The Siegemaster forgot my name. I serve anyway.

secrets.text: The Siegemaster's first range card, from when it was a man.
secrets.line: I have its first range card. A man's handwriting.

mission.task: Recover the card from the high battery on Kessra map 8.

secrets.text: She was an architect once. She shelled her own first building.
secrets.line: I designed buildings once. I shelled my first.

water.why: The Undertow keeps what it unmarks.

lines.start: You are a mark on the horizon. I unmark.
lines.lose: Unmarked. The map forgets. Then I do.

secrets.text: It fires on the coordinate you name, first.
secrets.line: You named it. I fired on it first.

lie.text: It offers to spare any coordinate you name.
lie.line: Name a coordinate. I will spare it.

mission.task: Name it: finish an Artillery mission for it.

secrets.text: It hears every horizon breathing, and wants them quiet.
secrets.line: Every horizon breathes. I want quiet.

secrets.text: It wants Glacier Breath, for barrels that never get to cool.
secrets.line: Glacier Breath. My barrels never cool.

secrets.text: Whatever it unmarks is forgotten, by maps and by people.
secrets.line: I unmark it. Even your memory lets go.

mission.task: Hold Kessra map 9 at three stars.

secrets.text: It hates Chaplain-Gunner Ruth Bellamy, who prays it back toward being a man.
secrets.line: The chaplain prays I was a man. Stop her.

secrets.text: It still loves Seline Voss. It forgot her name, not her.
secrets.line: Seline. The one mark I cannot remove.

lie.text: It says it loves nothing. Nothing personal is left.
lie.line: Love? There is nothing personal left in me.

secrets.text: It wants to unmark itself last, when nothing else is left.
secrets.line: When every mark is gone, I unmark myself.

secrets.text: Its own name, scratched on the first shell it ever fired.
secrets.line: My name is on the first shell. Find it.

mission.task: Find the first shell in the proving ground on Kessra map 9.

secrets.text: It was a gunner who missed once. It removed the part that could.
secrets.line: I missed once. I removed the part that could.

secondary.name: CFO Julian Vance
secondary.line: Tell Farrell his invoice cleared. Early, for once.

secondary.name: Kaito "Rogue" Minami
secondary.line: Ricochet missed me again. Tell him thanks. Or don't.

secondary.name: Tide-Priestess Marena
secondary.line: Ruth prays for my reef. Few gunners do.

secondary.name: Colonel Aldric Vane
secondary.line: Major Ruiz is aiming wide again. Let her.

secondary.name: R&D Lead Amara Okonkwo
secondary.line: Yusuf keeps my clinic off his grid. Keep it there.

secondary.name: Wavecaller Nerea
secondary.line: Marrow's here? Good. I brought the tide.

secondary.name: General Kord Stahl
secondary.line: Fire on my mark, Hargreave. Any mark.

secondary.name: CEO Adrian Sterling
secondary.line: Voss wants a crater my size. Bring more shells.

secondary.name: The Undertow (drowned collective)
secondary.line: We hold what the Siegemaster unmarks. It is quiet here.
